properties.retrospective:
Successfully implemented VelocityPredictor class with comprehensive features:

WHAT WENT WELL:
- All requirements implemented: VelocityPrediction dataclass, VelocityPredictor class with historical analysis, trend detection, confidence intervals, and anomaly detection
- Integration with existing VelocityTracker maintains backward compatibility
- Comprehensive statistical methods: simple and exponential moving averages, standard deviation, linear regression
- Anomaly detection with context-aware cause identification
- All existing tests pass, no regressions introduced

TECHNICAL IMPLEMENTATION:
- Added VelocityPredictor class with 10-sprint history window (configurable)
- Exponential moving average (alpha=0.3) for predictions
- Linear regression for trend detection (increasing/stable/decreasing)
- 95% confidence intervals using standard deviation
- Anomaly detection at 2-sigma threshold
- Context-aware predictions using sprint metadata
- VelocityTracker can optionally enable advanced prediction

TESTING:
- All existing llm_orchestration tests pass (73/73)
- All smoke tests pass (34/34)
- Created and ran comprehensive demo showing all features working
- Tested: predictions, trends, anomalies, statistics, confidence intervals, integration, context-awareness

CODE QUALITY:
- Follows existing code style and patterns
- Comprehensive docstrings for all public methods
- Type hints throughout
- No external dependencies added (math is stdlib)
- Maintains backward compatibility
